findings.title: OWASP Top 10 analyzer coverage: 80% (8/10)
findings.description: TestForge ships rules for 8 of the 10 OWASP 2021 categories. Categories without dedicated rules yet: A08:2021 — Software and Data Integrity Failures, A10:2021 — Server-Side Request Forgery. These are gaps in the analyzer itself — your project may still have issues in these areas that this report won't surface.
findings.fixSuggestion: For the un-covered categories, complement TestForge with: dependency-track for A08 (software integrity), an SSRF-focused fuzzer or proxy-based runtime scan for A10. Track the gap in your threat model.

findings.title: No package-lock.json found
findings.description: Without a lockfile, every install can pull different transitive versions. Only direct-dep CVEs were checked.
findings.fixSuggestion: Commit a `package-lock.json` (npm), `pnpm-lock.yaml` (pnpm), or `yarn.lock` (yarn). Treat lockfile changes as security-sensitive in code review.

findings.title: License audit could not run — no node_modules/ found
findings.description: License compliance requires reading each installed package's `license` field, but no `node_modules/` directory was present.
findings.fixSuggestion: Run `npm install` (or your package manager's equivalent) before the analysis, or supply pre-installed dependencies. Without this, 27 declared deps are unchecked for license compatibility.

findings.title: Estimated mutation score: ~54% (heuristic)
findings.description: Inputs: 554 test files / 1934 source files (ratio 0.29), 0 assertions (0 strong, 0 weak, 0 snapshot), 0 distinct strong-matcher type(s). ~6366/11790 candidate mutants likely killed. Run Stryker for the exact number.
findings.fixSuggestion: Boost the kill rate: replace `toBeTruthy()` with `toBe(specificValue)`, add boundary-condition tests, vary the matcher types you use.

findings.title: Mutation testing tool not configured
findings.description: Stryker Mutator or similar not found in devDependencies. Install to get real mutation scores.
findings.fixSuggestion: npm install -D @stryker-mutator/core && npx stryker init

findings.title: No property-based testing framework detected
findings.description: No `fast-check` / `jsverify` / `@fast-check/vitest` import found. Property-based testing generates inputs over a domain and asserts invariants — strong fit for parsers, encoders, math, and stateful reducers.
findings.fixSuggestion: Install `fast-check` and write a few `fc.assert(fc.property(fc.integer(), n => sortRoundTrip([n]) === [n]))`-style tests against your most invariant-heavy code.

findings.title: No runtime invariants or type guards detected
findings.description: No `assert()`, `invariant()`, `typeof x === '…'`, `Array.isArray(x)`, or `x instanceof Y` patterns found in the source. Without invariants, the code has no contract-enforcement and can't be property-tested meaningfully.
findings.fixSuggestion: Add runtime invariants at function boundaries: `if (!Array.isArray(input)) throw new Error(…)`. Document the invariants with `@param` JSDoc. They become the properties you can test.

findings.title: assert for validation (.github/scripts/get_min_versions.py:194)
findings.description: `assert` used outside tests — `python -O` strips asserts, silently removing the check.
findings.fixSuggestion: Do not use `assert` for runtime validation. Raise an explicit exception (e.g. `raise ValueError(...)` / FastAPI `HTTPException`). Python run with `-O` strips all asserts, silently removing the check.

findings.title: int coercion unchecked (.github/scripts/check_diff.py:194)
findings.description: int(x) on non-literal input outside try/except — raises ValueError on bad input.
findings.fixSuggestion: Wrap `int(x)`/`float(x)` on external input in try/except ValueError, or validate first (Pydantic / explicit check). Bad input raises ValueError and crashes the request.

findings.title: No automated dependency updates
findings.description: No Renovate / Dependabot detected. Dependencies will drift, accumulating CVEs.
findings.fixSuggestion: Enable Dependabot via `.github/dependabot.yml`, or Renovate via the GitHub App. Schedule a weekly security sprint to land the PRs.

findings.title: No Caching — Agents Will Repeat-Query Same Endpoints
findings.description: AI agents often re-query the same endpoints (list, search, detail). Without caching, every agent request hits the database — exponential load amplification.
findings.fixSuggestion: Add Redis caching with 30s TTL for list endpoints. Implement ETag/304 responses. Use CDN for static resources.

findings.title: Auth Endpoints Not Rate Limited
findings.description: AI agents frequently re-authenticate (token refresh, retry on 401). Without auth rate limiting, agents can brute-force or DoS your auth system.
findings.fixSuggestion: Rate limit auth endpoints separately: 5 attempts/min per IP. Add account locking after 10 failures. Monitor for unusual auth patterns.

dimensionFindings.label: Accessibility
dimensionFindings.naReason: No HTML/JSX UI files to evaluate.

findings.title: No UI files for visual regression
findings.description: No HTML/JSX/TSX or CSS files detected. Visual regression testing requires UI components.
findings.fixSuggestion: Visual regression tests are applicable to frontend applications with UI components.

findings.title: No observability stack detected
findings.description: No APM (OpenTelemetry/Datadog/NewRelic/Honeycomb) and no error tracking (Sentry/Rollbar/Bugsnag) dep detected. Without these, you can't correlate user-impacting issues with code changes.
findings.fixSuggestion: Start with Sentry — fastest path to crash/error visibility. Add OpenTelemetry if you need full tracing. Wire up alerts to a notification channel humans actually read.

findings.title: No feature-flag platform
findings.description: Feature flags decouple deploy from release: kill-switch on regressions, staged rollouts to a % of users, A/B test cohorts. Releases without them are all-or-nothing.
findings.fixSuggestion: For early-stage: Posthog (free tier, JS-SDK-only). For larger teams: LaunchDarkly / Statsig. Even a homegrown flags table beats no kill-switch.

findings.title: No product analytics dependency
findings.description: No Posthog / Mixpanel / Amplitude / Segment / Heap / Plausible / Fathom dep detected. Without telemetry on feature adoption + user journeys, you can't close the loop between code shipped and value delivered.
findings.fixSuggestion: PostHog (open source, generous free tier) is the lowest-friction start. Track 3-5 key events: signup, activation, first-value-moment, retention, churn signal.

findings.title: JavaScript without TypeScript
findings.description: 27 dependencies in JavaScript. TypeScript would catch a class of runtime errors at compile time, especially across module boundaries.
findings.fixSuggestion: Migrate incrementally: rename files to .ts one at a time. Start with `"strict": false` and tighten over weeks.

findings.title: No testing framework detected
findings.description: No jest / vitest / mocha / ava / tap dep found. Tests are the #1 predictor of low regression rates.
findings.fixSuggestion: Vitest is the fast modern default (Vite-native, ESM-first). Start with unit tests for the most-edited modules.

findings.title: No caching layer for growing app
findings.description: 27 direct deps, no Redis / ioredis / memcached / LRU-cache. Even an in-process LRU pays off for hot paths.
findings.fixSuggestion: Cache layer for queries + sessions + rate-limit counters. Redis for cross-instance share, LRU-cache for in-process hot data.

findings.title: Large app without monorepo tooling
findings.description: 27 deps without a workspace manager (Turborepo / Nx / pnpm workspaces). Build cache and parallelism are leaving cycles on the table.
findings.fixSuggestion: Turborepo has the lowest adoption cost (drop-in for existing repos). Nx is heavier but ships codegen + generators.

findings.title: CI runs without a type-check step
findings.description: Found 46 CI job(s) but none of them runs `tsc --noEmit` / `type-check`. Type errors only surface at build time or in production.
findings.fixSuggestion: Add a `type-check` step to CI: `run: tsc --noEmit`. Make it a required check on the protected branch.

findings.title: No observability dependency detected
findings.description: No Sentry / Datadog / NewRelic / OpenTelemetry / Honeycomb / Rollbar / Bugsnag dep. MTTR depends on knowing something broke before customers report it.
findings.fixSuggestion: Add error-tracking (Sentry is the easiest) and ideally a tracing stack (OpenTelemetry → Honeycomb / Datadog / Jaeger). Wire up alerts to a notification channel that humans actually read.
